article.title: Clarity串連代理流量與商品發現，Ask Clarity仍限封閉測試
article.title_en: Clarity connects agent traffic and product discovery; Ask Clarity remains in closed beta
article.summary: Microsoft於11月4日更新Clarity，讓網站團隊觀察代理行為，並擴展合資格商戶的Brand Agents。
article.summary_en: Microsoft’s November 4 Clarity update adds agent behavior tools and expands Brand Agents for eligible merchants.
highlights: 任務模擬先聚焦商務與旅遊場景。
Ask Clarity按會話證據回答問題，目前僅向零售商封閉測試。
highlights_en: Task simulations initially focus on commerce and travel.
Ask Clarity answers from session evidence and is in closed beta for retailers.
article.why: 旅遊及零售網站可分開檢查真人瀏覽與代理執行，找出預約或結帳流程的障礙。
article.why_en: Travel and retail sites can inspect human browsing and agent execution separately to locate booking or checkout friction.
article.next_step: 先查帳戶功能及商戶資格，再選一項搜尋至預約流程作模擬；把失敗步驟交網站團隊處理。
article.next_step_en: Check feature access and merchant eligibility, then simulate one search-to-booking task and assign failures to the web team.
article.detail: Brand Agents的商品發現擴展適用於合資格WooCommerce及Shopify商戶，產品可在Copilot、Bing及MSN等體驗出現，購買仍於商戶網站完成。本地服務預約則涉及合資格WordPress企業及支援的CRM或排程系統。這些功能的開放條件不同，不能因公告提到全球用戶，就認定全部帳戶已有Ask Clarity。模擬任務完成亦不等於真實消費者已成交。
article.detail_en: Product discovery covers eligible WooCommerce and Shopify merchants; shoppers complete purchases on the merchant site. Local booking involves eligible WordPress businesses and supported systems. These access conditions differ from Ask Clarity’s closed beta. A completed simulation is not a recorded sale.
